Based on: E-503

Seller:
Notice to our wholesale partners:
Due to higher packaging material costs, our baseline price per box increases from $40 to $44 starting this week.

Buyer:
Thanks for the update.
We need to order 30 boxes, but can you give us a 5% discount on the new $44 price to help offset the price hike?
Shipping can be your standard $18, due on receipt.

Seller:
We can do that for you this time.
We will apply a 5% discount to the new $44 price for your 30 boxes.
Shipping is $18, payment due on receipt.
